# Lab 11.10: Network Firewall Policy with FQDN & Geo Rules

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a global network firewall policy that allows egress only to approved domains and blocks ingress from chosen countries.

## Steps

1. **Create a lab VPC and VM.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute networks create fw-vpc --subnet-mode=custom
gcloud compute networks subnets create fw-subnet --network=fw-vpc --region=us-central1 --range=10.40.0.0/24
gcloud compute routers create fw-router --network=fw-vpc --region=us-central1
gcloud compute routers nats create fw-nat --router=fw-router --region=us-central1 \
  --auto-allocate-nat-external-ips --nat-all-subnet-ip-ranges
gcloud compute instances create fw-vm --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro --subnet=fw-subnet --no-address</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create the policy and attach it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute network-firewall-policies create lab-nfp --global
gcloud compute network-firewall-policies associations create \
  --firewall-policy=lab-nfp --network=fw-vpc --global-firewall-policy</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Allow IAP SSH, allow egress to one domain, deny other web egress.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute network-firewall-policies rules create 100 --firewall-policy=lab-nfp \
  --global-firewall-policy --direction=INGRESS --action=allow \
  --src-ip-ranges=35.235.240.0/20 --layer4-configs=tcp:22

gcloud compute network-firewall-policies rules create 200 --firewall-policy=lab-nfp \
  --global-firewall-policy --direction=EGRESS --action=allow \
  --dest-fqdns=www.google.com --layer4-configs=tcp:443 --enable-logging

gcloud compute network-firewall-policies rules create 300 --firewall-policy=lab-nfp \
  --global-firewall-policy --direction=EGRESS --action=deny \
  --dest-ip-ranges=0.0.0.0/0 --layer4-configs=tcp:80,tcp:443 --enable-logging</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Block ingress from selected countries.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute network-firewall-policies rules create 50 --firewall-policy=lab-nfp \
  --global-firewall-policy --direction=INGRESS --action=deny \
  --src-region-codes=KP,IR --layer4-configs=all --enable-logging</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Test egress.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute ssh fw-vm --zone=us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap \
  --command="curl -sI https://www.google.com | head -1; curl -sI -m5 https://example.com | head -1"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The first works. The second times out.

6. **Check the logs.** In Logs Explorer, filter `jsonPayload.rule_details.reference:"lab-nfp"` to see allowed and denied connections.

7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete fw-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute network-firewall-policies associations delete --firewall-policy=lab-nfp \
  --name=$(gcloud compute network-firewall-policies describe lab-nfp --global --format="value(associations[0].name)") \
  --global-firewall-policy
gcloud compute network-firewall-policies delete lab-nfp --global --quiet
gcloud compute routers delete fw-router --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute networks subnets delete fw-subnet --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud compute networks delete fw-vpc --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Egress to www.google.com | Allowed |
| Other web egress | Denied and logged |
| Geo rule | Blocks traffic from listed countries |
| Tier | FQDN and geolocation objects are in Cloud NGFW Standard |
